description: This file defines the OrganizationAPI class for a Human Resource Management system, implementing CRUD interface methods (mostly GET and PUT) for managing organization details via REST API. It includes API endpoints, validation rules, and service interactions for retrieving and updating organization info.

classes.name: OrganizationAPI
classes.description: API class for managing organization information, supporting getOne() and update() operations, providing validation rules, and persisting organization data via OrganizationService.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves current organization information, returning default empty values if none exist.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for fetching a single resource (expects a valid ID).

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to retrieve list of organizations.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Not implemented; validation rules for getAll.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Not implemented; validation rules for create.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates organization information with data provided in request body and returns updated info.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for updating organization info.

methods.name: saveOrganizationInfo
methods.description: Extracts data from request parameters, updates or creates the Organization entity, and saves it.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; validation rules for delete.
